distinctions.cost_share: ratio of scalar realized objective components; not gradients
distinctions.direct_policy_gradient: diagnostic at original pre-update weights and original frozen joint standardized GAE
distinctions.adam_actual_update: only checkpoint-to-checkpoint total net parameter delta observed; no per-cost attribution
distinctions.recorded_gradient_norm: mean over all minibatches and epochs of clip_grad_norm_ returned preclip norm
distinctions.critic_mse: before uses following on-policy batch; after is same-batch training fit
distinctions.raw_rpc_reward: legacy RPC evidence is validated by training admission; analysis uses negative frozen rebuilt joint cost, not legacy raw RPC reward

interpretation.convergence: Strong improvement into a low-cost region; insufficient evidence of stable optimization convergence. The frozen update13 generalizes to100 new shifts; later training policies have noisier higher cost.
interpretation.reward_implementation: All16 batches rebuilt from canonical material events and recorded physical waiting/production agree with original costs, MC, raw GAE and single joint standardization. No Actor/Critic objective mismatch found.
interpretation.reward_signal: The grade deadband sparsifies direct realized grade cost but does not eliminate delayed grade GAE or frozen Critic bootstrap information. Direct waiting policy gradients remain smaller and sometimes oppose joint policy gradient.
interpretation.critic: Late raw MSE is much lower while target variance also shrinks. Independent pooled EV remains0.16849; the value model is useful but has substantial residual error.
interpretation.actor_updates: Mean preclip total gradient norms above0.5 establish some clipping, not its frequency. Later net checkpoint parameter changes remain about5% of prior Actor parameter L2.
interpretation.adam: Cost-specific Adam attribution is unavailable. Autograd norms, cosines and signed projections diagnose one frozen full-batch surrogate only; actual checkpoint-to-checkpoint delta is the net joint four-epoch Adam result.

gradient_method.decomposition: A_joint=A_grade(zeroV)+A_production(zeroV)+A_wait(zeroV)+A_value(zeroCost,oldV); center each term by its own full-batch mean and divide every term by the same original joint std+1e-8.
gradient_method.old_value_term: sum_l lambda^l*(V_{t+l+1}-V_{t+l}); at lambda=.95 this includes future-value bootstrapping and is not only a current-state subtractive baseline. Actor gradients do not propagate into the frozen Critic.
gradient_method.gradient: For each component use mean(ratio*its_joint_scaled_advantage) at original pre-update weights; separately entropy=-.01*mean(H). Joint gradient is recomputed through original max(r*A,clip(r)*A) surrogate.
gradient_method.clipping: All replay ratios differ from1 by at most1.20e-6; zero rows outside[.8,1.2]. Decomposition therefore applies to the pre-update unclipped point and is not a decomposition of four epochs of clipped Adam updates.
gradient_method.centering: Independent centering is algebraically additive because the common denominator is unchanged. It is a defined decomposition, not unique causal credit assignment.
gradient_method.aggregation: All original32 shifts and all decisions, equally weighted by decision count, recomputed in bounded16-row chunks; no optimizer step, no input intervention, no new simulation.
gradient_method.diagnostics: l2_norm, dot, cosine and signed projection against joint policy gradient; projections can be negative or exceed1 and are not Adam shares. Pairwise cosines and module squared-gradient fractions are diagnostic only.
missing_actual_logs: per-minibatch preclip norm distribution or clipping frequency
per-step Adam parameter delta by objective
